owner: Hypersolve RecursiveQuadraticValue::compute_exact_real_witness, tensor evaluation over retained selected sources
input_domain: Admitted native recursive fields with finite dense coefficient tensors, including padded zero powers, multiple source axes and defining-relation reduction. A generator may have no represented Real witness.
missing_witness: The public evaluator promises that unused generators impose no reconstruction requirement, but skips a generator only when the stored axis dimension equals1. Tensor construction preserves padding, and quotient reduction retains a full degree-sized axis even when all variable coefficients vanish.
proposed_tests: A padded exact constant over an unwitnessed cubic selected source must return that constant while retaining its field.
A polynomial reduced by the selected cubic relation to a constant must return the independent exact expectation.
Mixed known/unknown generators in both axis orders exercise row-major strides and zero coefficient slices.
A nonzero coefficient as small as2^-80 still requires the unknown generator; zero padding must not hide an actual dependency.
candidate_fix: Before requiring an unavailable generator witness, prove every higher-power coefficient slice in this fixed-prefix tensor is a coefficientwise represented exact zero. If so, evaluate only the constant slice. Otherwise retain existing None. Do not infer zero by tolerance, sample, or unbounded equality search.
proof: A tensor block with every positive power coefficient exactly zero is independent of that generator at every value; this is a structural polynomial identity. The field, all selected source definitions, original tensor and source guards remain unchanged. Only the memoized exact scalar image is recovered.
resource_contract: Finite scan of existing coefficient storage with checked slice arithmetic. No generator elimination, new retained graph, negative cache or independent coordinate materialization. No total solver-work bound implied.
downstream: Native value arithmetic/sign filters, selected polynomial field import and query coefficients, exact graph replay and curve consumers. Original repeated chamfer remains a separately measured open witness; this scalar fix alone does not claim its completion.
